Our Story

A small kitchen with one big fire.

Ember & Oak began in 2016 with a single oak-fired grill and a simple idea: cook the way people have cooked for centuries — over real wood, with whatever the farms around us are picking that week.

Today our kitchen works with eleven local growers, bakes its bread in the embers each morning, and still lights the grill at 4 PM sharp. No gas, no shortcuts — just fire, seasonality and patience.

11Local farm partners
